name: ACP Dashboard Binding
description: SessionBindingAdapter for the internal webchat channel: resolves agent-qualified dashboard conversation keys to ACP harness session targets (codex/claude/opencode).

boundAgents.description: Explicit allowlist of agent ids that may be auto-bound. Overrides the orchestrator safe-default exclusion.

excludedAgents.description: Replaces the default orchestrator exclusion when boundAgents is unset.

harnessSessions.description: Per-harness mapping to a real persistent ACP session key (created by /acp spawn). Dashboard conversations route to these instead of synthetic binding keys.

harnessReplyWaitMs.description: Clamped wait window (1000..900000, default 120000) for the harness turn reply in the inbound claim path.

workspaces.description: Explicit cwd override map: keys are exact dashboard conversation ids (agent:<id>:dashboard:<uuid>) or project ids, values are absolute workspace paths. Wins over the origin derivation; below the harnessSessions override.

deriveOriginWorkspace.description: Default true: derive the origin conversation's workspace cwd from the host agent DB (read-only) and spawn/ensure the bound harness session in that cwd with a per-cwd-scoped session key. Set false to keep the agent-default cwd ladder only.

bindMainSessions.description: Default true (Phase 2.24b session-key clone mode): also bind the MAIN conversation of a roster harness agent (agent:<id>:main) to a deterministic clone ACP session (the ghost key shape becomes ensured). Set false to keep main conversations on untouched builtin dispatch. The roster gates (boundAgents/excludedAgents/default orchestrator exclusion) always apply.

harnesses.description: Phase 3 (additive to bundled acpx, NOT a replacement): normalized per-harness config. The plugin generates the harness-native file/env config for ONLY the harnesses listed here (codex+opencode: config files for OpenAI-compatible local backends; claude/gemini/droid/qwen/kimi/kiro/iflow: harness-env/<id>.env, sourced by the plugins.entries.acpx.config.agents.<id>.command/args override — BRIDGE.md §15). ABSENCE of a harness id (or this whole section) = plugin writes NOTHING for it: native subscriptions (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, Copilot-OAuth) run unchanged via bundled acpx vendor auth. Changes apply on next boot.

model.description: Required, non-empty: the model id to claim for this harness.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible backend base URL (Ollama/vLLM/LocalAI/llama.cpp). Required for codex/opencode (file mechanism); appended with /v1 exactly once where the CLI expects it.

apiKey.description: API key/token the harness backend expects (auth.json OPENAI_API_KEY for codex, apiKey option for opencode, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN/KIRO_API_KEY/... for env harnesses). Placeholder 'ollama' when omitted.

thinking.description: Codex only: model_reasoning_effort written when non-empty.
